newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon says Israeli troops fire at school bus.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon says Israeli troops fire at school bus.

text.p: Israeli troops opened fire at a school bus in southeastern Lebanon on Sunday, hitting the bus but causing no casualties, Beirut's official National News Agency reported.
The agency said Israeli soldiers at al-Ahmadiyah and Kawkaba hills opened machinegun fire at a bus carrying 30 schoolchildren on the road to Qilya in the southern tip of the Bekaa Valley.
The schoolbus was hit by many bullets but the children escaped injury, it said.
Israeli troops occupy a 15 km (nine mile) wide border strip in south Lebanon.
